risk: Incorrect typed method dispatch can redirect authenticated writes or expose private transfer evidence; server scope and ownership remain authoritative.
justification: Reviewed all 78 transport method keys: getVenue reads the existing GET /social-events/venues/{id} endpoint so the events page can name venues referenced by loaded events that fall outside the bounded venue list page. The key is typed HTTP dispatch, not a selectable venue or business catalog; persisted Venue rows remain authoritative. The prior 77-method review is retained as previousDecision.
